corrections: Initial higher/wider shoal spread its ramp toward the channel centre and over-grounded edge cases. Deep core now starts4m from the left bank at full shoal,crest is22–23cm below still water,centre/checkpoint lanes stay unchanged.

Vertical bed normals previously suppressed all paddle propulsion. Actual bed contact now has bounded tangential slip resistance with the same260N total cap and no vertical contact force; passive/rest/release regressions pass.

Escape acceptance measures clearance beneath the whole keel rather than requiring an arbitrary20m upstream destination. One actual grounded case and3 nearby shallow cases are explicitly distinguished.
Native review found an old checkpoint board obstructing the new sandbar approach. Board now stands across the pool; final rerun/screenshot show the boat and water clear.

First timing capture retains multiple CPU/GPU misses. Removed redundant stationary bed recomputation/uploads; wave and same-tick relocation assertions pass. Final water-update CPU p95 is0.5–0.6ms; High rapids/rescue CPU,High trees GPU and all strict frame-interval targets still miss. Unchanged camera/reflection also got faster,so the whole timing difference is not attributed to the cache.
limits: Near-bed drag is a bounded gameplay approximation,not a shallow-water fluid solver or suction model.
Ground push uses actual bed contact with bounded viscous tangential response,not a fully articulated paddle with Coulomb load.
Manual capsize rescue,full-route human pacing,premium art,Internet/device/long-browser acceptance remain open.
